name: cargo-binstall
description: cargo-binstall — binary installation for Rust cargo tools. Install Rust CLI tools from prebuilt binaries instead of compiling from source.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/releases/download/v1.19.1/cargo-binstall-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tgz && tar xzf cargo-binstall-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tgz && sudo mv cargo-binstall /usr/local/bin/ && rm cargo-binstall-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tgz

commands.description: cargo-binstall — binary installation for Rust cargo tools. Install Rust CLI tools from prebuilt binaries instead of compiling from source.
